codeReview.summary: The fix resolves the prior blocking concurrency flaw by reusing a single handler-scoped VersionStore instance and adds regression coverage that exercises concurrent PUT and rollback requests while asserting monotonic, gap-free version history.

summary: Pass: the original blocking issue from prompt-stack-api (per-request VersionStore instantiation causing unsafe concurrent history updates) is addressed. The handler now caches a shared VersionStore and new tests verify store reuse plus concurrent update/rollback history integrity with contiguous version sequencing. No remaining blocking or non-blocking issues were identified for this fix feature.
